rules.justification: Do not allow dependency, staging, or verification bypasses hidden inside otherwise approved command families.
Do not delete or execute through find; it is allowed as a read-only inspection command.
Do not pass arguments to an agent Herdr starts, except the Sonnet or Opus model at medium effort for Claude lanes; others could switch off its sandbox, hooks, or approvals.
Do not open file: or chrome: URLs in the browser; it runs outside the sandbox and would read files the sandbox denies, such as ~/.ssh or .env, or change browser settings.

patterns: (^|[ =/.])(ghostty|terminal|iterm2?|warp(-stable)?|alacritty|kitty|wezterm(-gui)?|hyper|tabby|system[[:space:]]+(settings|preferences)|systempreferences|keychain[[:space:]]+access|keychainaccess|passwords|1password|onepassword[0-9]*|script[[:space:]]+editor|scripteditor2?|automator|shortcuts|ターミナル|システム設定|システム環境設定|キーチェーンアクセス|パスワード|スクリプトエディタ|ショートカット)(\.app)?([ /:]|$)
rules.justification: Do not operate terminals, System Settings, Keychain Access, Passwords, 1Password, Script Editor, Automator, or Shortcuts by English or Japanese name, bundle ID, or path; typing into them runs commands or changes security settings outside the sandbox and the hooks.
